sections.heading: Identity and current status
sections.body:
- Project ID: `devin`
- Canonical name: Devin (`claim-devin-identity`)
- Vendor: Cognition AI, Inc. (`claim-devin-sf-vendor`, `claim-devin-sf-cognition-operates`)
- Vendor/platform versus surface: Cognition is the vendor. Official family surfaces are Devin Cloud, Devin Desktop, Devin CLI, and Devin Review. This pack keeps one project id (`claim-devin-sf-family-surfaces`). Windsurf is already a canonical duplicate of `devin` (`claim-devin-sf-windsurf-rename`, `claim-devin-sf-blog-desktop`, `claim-devin-sf-lineage-windsurf`). Cascade is a retired local agent inside Desktop, not a second product id (`claim-devin-sf-cascade-sunset`, `claim-devin-sf-cascade-faq`).
- Current status: actively shipped; checked cloud release notes through 2026-08-14 (`claim-devin-sf-status`, `claim-devin-sf-maintenance`). Windsurf brand became Devin Desktop on 2026-06-02 (`claim-devin-sf-windsurf-rename`). Official blog: legacy Cascade available through 2026-07-01 (`claim-devin-sf-cascade-sunset`). Devin Local is the primary local agent (`claim-devin-sf-devin-local-primary`). Enterprise leftover Cascade controls remain documented (`claim-devin-sf-cascade-enterprise-default-off`, `claim-devin-sf-cascade-enterprise-scope`).
- Last source-backed identity check: 2026-08-15 (`claim-devin-sf-canonical-url`, `claim-devin-sf-repository-url`)

sections.heading: What it is and is not
sections.body:
- What it is: an autonomous AI software engineer that writes, runs, and tests code (`claim-devin-sf-what-it-is`).
- What it is not: not an open-source runtime (`claim-devin-sf-what-it-is-not-oss`). Not a product that currently accepts third-party LLM API keys (`claim-devin-sf-what-it-is-not-byok`). Not positioned for extremely difficult unscoped work beyond a three-hour rule of thumb (`claim-devin-sf-not-extremely-hard`). Not a second product id from Windsurf; Desktop is the renamed Windsurf IDE (`claim-devin-sf-windsurf-rename`). Not a live Cascade product (`claim-devin-sf-cascade-sunset`).

sections.heading: Architecture and agent-loop ownership
sections.body:
- Primary type: `cloud-agent` by inference from first-party cloud-agent docs (`claim-devin-sf-primary-type`)
- Secondary roles: Desktop is an `ide` surface (`claim-devin-sf-secondary-ide`); CLI is inferred as a local `runtime` (`claim-devin-sf-secondary-runtime`)
- Agent-loop owner: Cognition Cloud Brain owns the cloud loop (`claim-devin-sf-agent-loop-owner`). Outposts keep that loop in Devin Cloud while tools run on customer machines (`claim-devin-sf-outposts-split`).
- Architecture: stateless Brain in Cognition Cloud plus an isolated Devbox with shell, browser, and editor (`claim-devin-sf-architecture-brain-devbox`). Devin Local is the primary local harness, shared with Devin CLI (`claim-devin-sf-devin-local-primary`).

sections.heading: Surfaces and execution location
sections.body:
- Surface IDs: `surface-devin-web-app`, `surface-devin-cli`, `surface-devin-desktop`, `surface-devin-slack`, `surface-devin-teams`, `surface-devin-api`, `surface-devin-jetbrains-plugin`, `surface-devin-outposts-worker`, `surface-devin-pwa-mobile`, `surface-devin-desktop-ssh`
- Execution location: Cognition-hosted Linux VM (`claim-devin-sf-execution-linux-vm`), isolated Enterprise Cloud machine (`claim-devin-sf-execution-isolated-machine`), customer-dedicated VPC (`claim-devin-sf-execution-dedicated-vpc`), Outpost worker (`claim-devin-sf-execution-outposts`), same-device CLI (`claim-devin-sf-execution-cli-local`), same-device Desktop (`claim-devin-sf-execution-desktop-local`), optional Windows VM (`claim-devin-sf-execution-windows`)

sections.heading: Model/auth/provider strategy
sections.body:
- Model strategy: vendor-managed Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Cognition, and selected open-source models, plus Adaptive routing (`claim-devin-sf-model-strategy`, `claim-devin-sf-adaptive`). Third-party LLM API keys are not supported (`claim-devin-sf-what-it-is-not-byok`).
- Auth strategy: Devin account at app.devin.ai (`claim-devin-sf-auth-app`); Enterprise SSO via Okta, Entra, SAML, or OIDC (`claim-devin-sf-auth-sso`); SCIM GA (`claim-devin-sf-auth-scim`); API service-user keys or PATs (`claim-devin-sf-auth-api`). CLI enterprise login is `devin auth login` (`claim-devin-sf-auth-cli`).
- Provider support: paid plans advertise OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Cognition SWE models (`claim-devin-sf-provider-support`)

sections.heading: Context, memory, compaction, and session behavior
sections.body:
- Context behavior: AGENTS.md load before coding (`claim-devin-sf-context-behavior`)
- Memory: cloud Knowledge persists across sessions (`claim-devin-sf-memory-knowledge`). Cascade memories persist on Desktop and apply to Cascade only (`claim-devin-sf-memory-cascade`). Devin Local does not persist memories (`claim-devin-sf-memory-local-none`).
- Compaction: CLI/Local harness has a PostCompaction hook. Cloud compaction details are unknown (`claim-devin-sf-compaction-cli`).
- Session behavior: snapshot-boot (`claim-devin-sf-session-snapshot`); take-over and resume (`claim-devin-sf-session-takeover`); CLI `/handoff` (`claim-devin-sf-session-handoff`); Slack sync (`claim-devin-sf-session-slack-sync`); Slack unarchive (`claim-devin-sf-session-slack-unarchive`); Slack sleep/archive (`claim-devin-sf-session-sleep-archive`)

sections.heading: Tools, extensions, MCP, skills, hooks, and APIs
sections.body:
- Tools: shell, embedded VS Code IDE, interactive browser (`claim-devin-sf-tools`). Live Computer Use is a 1024×768 desktop: Linux and Windows supported; Outposts Linux supported with an X session; Outposts macOS supported with Screen Recording and Accessibility; macOS (Devin Cloud) not available (`claim-devin-sf-computer-use-2026-08-15`). A 2026-08-14 capture recorded a blanket macOS unsupported (`claim-devin-sf-computer-use`).
- Extensions: getting-started says marketplace installs are not available (`claim-devin-sf-extensions-no-marketplace`). VS Code/Cursor import is on getting-started (`claim-devin-sf-extensions-import`). Open VSX is on the recommended-extensions page (`claim-devin-sf-extensions-open-vsx`). Agent plugins bundle skills across Cloud, CLI, and Desktop (`claim-devin-sf-plugins`).
- MCP: stdio, SSE, and HTTP (`claim-devin-sf-mcp`)
- Skills: SKILL.md / Agent Skills (`claim-devin-sf-skills`)
- Hooks: CLI lifecycle hooks, including PostCompaction (`claim-devin-sf-hooks`)
- APIs: REST v3 (`claim-devin-sf-api`). Terraform `devin_automation` is a 7 August 2026 release note (`claim-devin-sf-api-terraform`).

sections.heading: Orchestration and parallelism
sections.body:
- Orchestration: coordinator Devin launches managed child sessions in isolated VMs (`claim-devin-sf-orchestration`)
- Parallelism: pricing lists up to 10 concurrent on Free/Pro and unlimited on Max/Team; Enterprise has no visible concurrent-limit cell (`claim-devin-sf-parallelism`). CLI/Local subagents run in foreground or background (`claim-devin-sf-subagents`).

sections.heading: Isolation, permissions, security, and data path
sections.body:
- Isolation: snapshot boot (`claim-devin-sf-isolation-cloud`). Enterprise Cloud uses an isolated machine per session (`claim-devin-sf-isolation-enterprise-machine`). CLI OS sandbox is optional, fail-closed, and unsupported on Windows (`claim-devin-sf-isolation-cli-sandbox`).
- Permissions: CLI/Local deny/ask/allow rules (`claim-devin-sf-permissions-cli`)
- Security: encryption in transit and at rest, SOC 2 Type II cited March 2024, Trust Center; vendor still requires human review of output (`claim-devin-sf-security`)
- Data path: Brain always in Cognition Cloud; Devbox in multi-tenant cloud or dedicated VPC (`claim-devin-sf-data-path`). Outpost machines are a separate page (`claim-devin-sf-data-path-outposts`). Default self-serve may train; paid opt-out enables ZDR; Enterprise trains only with written consent (`claim-devin-sf-data-training`).

sections.heading: Interface inventory plus remote/mobile/background behavior
sections.body:
List each surface from `surfaces.jsonl` separately. Keep native mobile, first-party mobile web, first-party messaging, vendor relay, remote client, private-network, Termux/mobile terminal, and generic remote shell routes distinct.

- Interface and surface IDs:
  - Web: `surface-devin-web-app` (`claim-devin-sf-surface-web`)
  - Local CLI: `surface-devin-cli` (`claim-devin-sf-surface-cli`, `claim-devin-sf-surface-cli-vs-cloud`, `claim-devin-sf-cli-handoff`)
  - Desktop: `surface-devin-desktop` (`claim-devin-sf-surface-desktop`, `claim-devin-sf-surface-desktop-cloud`)
  - First-party mobile web: `surface-devin-pwa-mobile` (`claim-devin-sf-surface-pwa`, `claim-devin-sf-mobile-pwa`)
  - Native iOS/Android: unknown (`claim-devin-sf-mobile-native-unknown`)
  - Messaging: `surface-devin-slack`, `surface-devin-teams` (`claim-devin-sf-surface-slack`, `claim-devin-sf-surface-teams`)
  - IDE plugin: `surface-devin-jetbrains-plugin` (`claim-devin-sf-surface-jetbrains`)
  - API: `surface-devin-api` (`claim-devin-sf-surface-api`)
  - Remote client / Outposts: `surface-devin-outposts-worker` (`claim-devin-sf-surface-outposts`)
  - Remote client / Desktop SSH: `surface-devin-desktop-ssh` (`claim-devin-sf-remote-ssh-desktop`)
  - Private-network, generic remote shell, and terminal-on-mobile: unknown. No first-party surface rows.
- Remote behavior: CLI `/handoff` plus web-app tracking (`claim-devin-sf-remote-handoff`); Desktop cloud-delegate (`claim-devin-sf-surface-desktop-cloud`); Slack start/resume (`claim-devin-sf-surface-slack`); Outposts outbound HTTPS (`claim-devin-sf-outposts-split`)
- Mobile behavior: PWA (`claim-devin-sf-mobile-pwa`); native store apps unknown (`claim-devin-sf-mobile-native-unknown`)
- Background behavior: automations (`claim-devin-sf-background-automations`); cloud VM after laptop close (`claim-devin-sf-background-laptop-close`); background subagents (`claim-devin-sf-background-subagents`)

sections.heading: Pricing, license, maintenance, and lock-in
sections.body:
- Pricing: Free $0; Pro $20/month; Max $200/month; Teams $80/month minimum plus $40 per full seat; Enterprise custom (`claim-devin-sf-pricing`)
- License: proprietary hosted Service; customer owns Output (`claim-devin-sf-license`, `claim-devin-sf-what-it-is-not-oss`)
- Maintenance: release notes current through 2026-08-14 (`claim-devin-sf-maintenance`)
- Lock-in: Cognition-hosted Brain and no customer LLM keys (`claim-devin-sf-lock-in`); default self-serve training unless opted out (`claim-devin-sf-data-training`)

sections.heading: Lineage and compatibility edges
sections.body:
- Lineage claims: Devin Desktop is former Windsurf (`claim-devin-sf-lineage-windsurf`, `claim-devin-sf-windsurf-rename`, `claim-devin-sf-blog-desktop`). Cascade sunset is a local-agent replacement, not a product merge (`claim-devin-sf-cascade-sunset`).
- Relationship edges:
  - `devin --connects_via--> claude-code` (`claim-devin-sf-acp-third-party`)
  - `devin --connects_via--> codex-family` (`claim-devin-sf-acp-third-party`)
  - `devin --connects_via--> opencode` (`claim-devin-sf-acp-third-party`)
  - `devin --connects_via--> gemini-cli` (`claim-devin-sf-acp-third-party`)
- Inbound handoff from other local agents is documented but is not a Devin-sourced wraps_cli edge (`claim-devin-sf-handoff-other-agents`)

sections.heading: Unique edge, meaningful drawbacks, best fit, and not-for
sections.body:
- Unique edge: autonomous cloud engineer with shell, embedded IDE, and browser (`claim-devin-sf-unique-value`)
- Meaningful drawbacks: hallucinations and insecure output (`claim-devin-sf-drawback-hallucination`); three-hour heuristic (`claim-devin-sf-drawback-three-hour`); CLI missing Knowledge/Playbooks/Secrets (`claim-devin-sf-drawback-cli-parity`)
- Best fit: ambitious engineering teams (`claim-devin-sf-intended-user`)
- Not-for: customer LLM keys (`claim-devin-sf-not-for-byok`); extremely hard unscoped tasks (`claim-devin-sf-not-for-hard`)

### Unresolved contradictions

- Memory persistence: cloud Knowledge and Cascade memories persist (`claim-devin-sf-memory-knowledge`, `claim-devin-sf-memory-cascade`); Devin Local does not persist memories (`claim-devin-sf-memory-local-none`). Do not average these into one memory cell.
- CLI versus cloud Devin: docs call them separate tools and say CLI lacks Knowledge, Playbooks, and Secrets (`claim-devin-sf-surface-cli-vs-cloud`).
- Training: default self-serve may train; paid opt-out and Enterprise consent are different rules (`claim-devin-sf-data-training`).
- Cascade sunset versus leftover controls: official blog says legacy Cascade through 2026-07-01 (`claim-devin-sf-cascade-sunset`); FAQ says through July (`claim-devin-sf-cascade-faq`); Local page still documents Cascade disable/migration (`claim-devin-sf-devin-local-primary`); enterprise release notes still expose a Cascade scope (`claim-devin-sf-cascade-enterprise-default-off`, `claim-devin-sf-cascade-enterprise-scope`). Do not average these into “Cascade is fully gone” or “Cascade is still the default.”
- Desktop extensions: getting-started denies marketplace installs (`claim-devin-sf-extensions-no-marketplace`); recommended-extensions describes Open VSX (`claim-devin-sf-extensions-open-vsx`). Do not average.
- Legal vendor naming: current Terms are Cognition AI, Inc.; some former Windsurf/Exafunction licenses may still name Exafunction, Inc. (`claim-devin-sf-vendor`).
- Outposts availability: current overview says Pro/Max/Teams, Dedicated Tenant off by default (`claim-devin-sf-outposts-availability`). The 22 July 2026 release note introduced Outposts as disabled by default (`claim-devin-sf-outposts-disabled-default`). Keep both dated statements.
- Computer Use macOS: 2026-08-14 blanket unsupported (`claim-devin-sf-computer-use`); live 2026-08-15 table supports Outposts macOS and marks only macOS (Devin Cloud) as not available (`claim-devin-sf-computer-use-2026-08-15`). Do not average.
